data.title: The difficult month upstairs

memoryNodes.cueZh: 团队看到没完成的订单。
米娜给等待的顾客打电话。

data.situation:
In October, fewer people stopped at the window. Local shopkeepers spoke of an economic downturn, but Mina could not tell from one quiet week whether the wider economy was in recession. Her immediate problem was a broken sewing machine. Replacing it before paying the rent could jeopardize the shop’s ability to survive the month. Jay brought the repair estimates upstairs, and Noor brought the October order book. The machine failure had become a crisis because several promised bags were unfinished. Some delay was inevitable; pretending otherwise would only leave customers waiting. They found a repairer who could inspect the machine on Friday. Mina crossed out the guessed completion dates and spent the afternoon making calls. The shop was quiet, but the upstairs telephone was not. Noor: Are we closing?
Mina: I do not know yet. Paying for a new machine now could jeopardize the rent payment.
Jay: The repairer can come on Friday.
Mina: Then we can give people that date for the inspection, without promising a date for every finished bag.

readingBlocks.en: In October, fewer people stopped at the window. Local shopkeepers spoke of an economic downturn, but Mina could not tell from one quiet week whether the wider economy was in recession. Her immediate problem was a broken sewing machine. Replacing it before paying the rent could jeopardize the shop’s ability to survive the month. Jay brought the repair estimates upstairs, and Noor brought the October order book. The machine failure had become a crisis because several promised bags were unfinished. Some delay was inevitable; pretending otherwise would only leave customers waiting. They found a repairer who could inspect the machine on Friday. Mina crossed out the guessed completion dates and spent the afternoon making calls. The shop was quiet, but the upstairs telephone was not.
readingBlocks.zh: 十月，停在橱窗前的人少了。本地店主谈到经济下行，但米娜无法仅凭清静的一周判断整个经济是否衰退。她眼前的问题是缝纫机坏了。交房租前就买新机器，可能危及小店撑过这个月的能力。杰伊把维修报价带到楼上，努尔带来十月订单本。机器故障成为危机，因为承诺的几个包还没完成。有些耽搁无法避免，假装没有问题只会让顾客继续等。他们找到一位维修师傅，周五能来检查机器。米娜划掉猜测的完工日期，整个下午打电话。店里很静，楼上电话却没闲下来。

readingBlocks.en:
Noor: Are we closing?
Mina: I do not know yet. Paying for a new machine now could jeopardize the rent payment.
Jay: The repairer can come on Friday.
Mina: Then we can give people that date for the inspection, without promising a date for every finished bag.
readingBlocks.zh:
努尔：我们要关店了吗？
米娜：还不知道。现在买新机器，可能影响交房租。
杰伊：维修师傅周五能来。
米娜：那我们可以告诉顾客检查日期，不必承诺每个包的完成日期。

glossary.note: a business survives；原小企业例句支持继续经营，不只人员幸存。
glossary.example: Mina wanted the shop to survive the difficult month.
glossary.exampleZh: 米娜希望小店撑过困难的月份。

externalEvidence.definition: continue in existence after (an adversity, etc.)

glossary.zh: 经济或经营活动的下降
glossary.note: an economic downturn；人物所说是故事信息，不把一周销售数据当宏观结论。
glossary.example: Local shopkeepers spoke of an economic downturn.
glossary.exampleZh: 本地店主谈到经济下行。

externalEvidence.definition: a worsening of business or economic activity

glossary.zh: 经济活动持续衰退的一段时期
glossary.note: in recession：处于经济衰退；指较广泛的经济活动下降。
glossary.example: Mina could not tell whether the wider economy was in recession.
glossary.exampleZh: 米娜无法判断整个经济是否处于衰退。

glossary.zh: 需要紧急处理的严重困难局面
glossary.note: a crisis；复数 crises，词形不新计。
glossary.example: The machine failure had become a crisis for the shop.
glossary.exampleZh: 机器故障成了小店的危机。

externalEvidence.definition: an unstable situation of extreme danger or difficulty

glossary.note: inevitable 不等于 merely likely；本事件有无法按时生产的具体原因。
glossary.example: Some delay was inevitable after the machine broke.
glossary.exampleZh: 机器坏后，有些耽搁无法避免。

externalEvidence.definition: incapable of being avoided or prevented

glossary.zh: 使某事面临失败或损害风险
glossary.note: jeopardize something；英式也写 jeopardise，同一单位。
glossary.example: Buying a machine immediately could jeopardize the rent payment.
glossary.exampleZh: 立刻买机器可能危及房租支付。

externalEvidence.definition: pose a threat to; present a danger to
